description: The file defines a PHP class `Article` within the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Cms`, handling CRUD operations, listing, and approval tasks for articles in an OpenCart admin module. It includes methods for listing articles, displaying forms, saving data, toggling status, rating, and deleting articles.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS articles in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list page of articles with filters, breadcrumbs, and links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to render the list of articles.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the articles list, including pagination, sorting, and filters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an article, loading related data like languages, topics, SEO URLs, layouts, and images.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating article data, with validation for permissions, input lengths, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Schedules a task to recalculate or update article ratings.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected articles by setting their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected articles by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected articles from the database.
